rounds.rule: A row gets ok only from a current listing, its own site or recent reviews with nothing saying closed (docs/EATS.md). A row is taken out when a search could not find the place at all or the sources disagree; a place found but not freshly confirmed stays without ok.

kept_without_ok.name: Central Chanthaburi food court

kept_without_ok.evidence: Wongnai listing not marked closed, but its newest data is from 2019; a Bangkok Biznews article mentions coffee and fried bread at the house, but its date could not be told apart from the site's header date Google Maps (2026-11-23): the inn (252 Sukhaphiban Rd) takes bookings for 26–27 Nov, but its own site (copyright 2013) names no café, only breakfast for guests; the café itself is not confirmed.
